## About Me 

I am a Senior Scientist at Uber and an Adjunct Assistant Professor of Statistics at the [University of Waterloo](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/). Previously, I held an appointment at the [University of British Columbia](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/).  My research spans: 

1. Statistical methods at the intersection of biostatistics and statistical learning, and  

2. Statistical theory and methodology for the optimal design of experiments.
